title: First Boot Linux retailer driver pack
description: manifest.json inside a shop .zip. Not official-catalog.json. One pack is one distro; editions are desktops (each ISO).

install.description: Must equal id. Folder name under payload/custom/ and DRIVER.id in driver.py.

secure_boot.description: Installer works with firmware Secure Boot on. Default false (shop-risk). Set true only when the live kernel and bootloader are signed.

logo.description: Basename in the zip. Default logo.png.

driver.description: Basename in the zip. Default driver.py. Same API as chooser/firstboot/osinstall/_template.py.

default.description: Exactly one true per pack. Featured card when that desktop is ticked.

filename.description: ISO basename written to payload/images/. May live in the zip, next to the zip, or be chosen in the creator.

sha256.description: Optional pin. When set, the creator rejects an ISO that does not match.

size_bytes.description: Optional pin. When set, the creator rejects an ISO of a different size.
